correctness.rationale: Every input subset has a unique three-symbol rough-pair output. The four-pair NFA with diagonal initial and terminal constraints recognizes exactly such words. All reachable subsets (12) and the complement-quotient weighted seven-state transitions are displayed; solving their exact suffix generating-function system yields the rational function, including all boundary terms. Separate bitmask exhaustive enumeration checks every subset for n=1..16, and a separately constructed deterministic automaton verifies transfer counts and recurrence through n=35. Finite checks corroborate, not substitute for, the all-length finite-automaton proof.

value.rationale: The cardinality of the entire lower–upper approximation image for a canonical nontransitive tolerance is a natural rough-set invariant. The theorem gives its exact all-size recurrence, a seven-state classification/recognizer, a rational generating function and an exponential asymptotic-compression law. It extends beyond trivial per-subset evaluation or a finite list of small cases, and its exact count is not implied by the inspected equivalence-based path results.
